text.text_excerpt: I used to come to this Walgreens fairly regularly back when I had friends who lived near it. I recently visited this Walgreens for the first time in a long time. This is a pretty typical Walgreens- they carry all of the usual Walgreens stuff. The staff at this location was pretty friendly when I dropped in and helped me find what I was looking for. I happened to be looking for a certain kind of vitamin for joint pain (not for me, btw) and the pharmacist pointed me in the right direction right away. Also, on the day I was here, they were having a pretty nice little sale on some makeup products, so I stocked up. The store and the pharmacy here are both open 24/7, so make note of that if you...

This is the best Walgreens I've ever been to! Amazing and knowledgeable employees, clean store, competitive prices with a rewards program. I usually stop by for random foodstuffs like chips or drinks. They JUST added a full liquor section which they didn't have before so this literally a one-stop shop for casual eating. If you need produce or meat I'd recommend the Rouses right across the street. Oh did I mention that this place is open 24 hours? Perfect for the fever that hits you or your kids at 3 in the morning. (What an inconvenient time to get sick AmIRite?)

Gets four stars for being open 24/7, clean, and has a friendly staff. Ever been on your own, sick, and not really felt up to driving but knew that you HAD to get something to relieve all your sinus pressure or you'd be more exhausted and thus more sick the next day? I HAVE! Walgreen's has saved me on more than one occasion. I also come here to get Pedialyte for the boyfriend when he gets headaches (it's for kids, but it's heavy on electrolytes and lower on sugar than Gatorade and thus better at relieving headaches caused by dehydration).
